claim: Blood often makes the source of an effect visible by letting the generator sprite be the thing itself: underwater weed (tile 660 or 664) that is a bubble generator (type 706 or 707), a stone face (tile 249) that is a fireball generator (703). Over the 43 campaign maps 112 generators of types 701-708 carry no invisible bit and are drawn in play; of the 139 bubble generators, 61 are visible weed. The engine hides only the trigger generator (700), so a generator that should not be seen must carry cstat 32768.
evidence: knowledge/blood/findings/probes/audit2_drawn_generators.py over the 43 campaign maps (2026-11-26): 131 sprites of types 700-712 without the invisible bit, 112 of them 701-708: 703 x41 (34 on tile 249), 706 x33 and 707 x28 (on 660/664), 702 x4, 701 x3, 708 x3
E1M4 sprite 339: type 706 on tile 660, cstat 128, state 1, busy_time 50, data_1 10 (a weed that bubbles); NBlood/source/blood/src/triggers.cpp:2350-2363 (InitGenerator hides kGenTrigger only)
use: Make a bubbling weed or a spitting face a visible generator on the right tile, cstat 128 like the campaign's; give every other generator and sound sprite cstat 32768.
